SignToki / About

A little Korean, before your trip.

SignToki is operated by 제레미 · Jeremy. It is a free, independent game for travelers and beginning Korean readers: eight topics, forty expressions, five questions at a time.

Read a shop's type, then its status, then its conditions. Our six guides show how the same word changes your decision in different contexts.

We create fictional storefronts and original explanations. AI assists illustration and translation drafts; Korean signs are rendered as actual text. Translations have not yet had independent native-speaker review. Dictionary and tourism links are further reading, not endorsements or copied articles.

The examples do not describe real businesses, current hours, prices or services. Romanization helps you start; browser audio depends on your device. Report a confusing word or translation through Contact.

SignTokiOriginal learning examples by SignToki. The illustrated places are fictional. Romanization helps you get started; use the Korean audio to hear the word.
